summary.zh-CN: 可在 DSH Web 任意位置拖拽且始终置顶的 3D 虚拟伙伴（three.js MMD 模型，待机呼吸/眨眼/说话口型/表情包）；单击开始语音聊天、说话可随时打断，双击打开设置面板，支持人物角色、背景信息、六种女声音色和流式实时回复。
summary.en-US: An always-on-top draggable 3D companion for DSH Web (three.js MMD model with idle breathing, blinking, lip-sync morphs and an expression pack); click to start voice chat with barge-in, double-click for settings: role, background, six female voices and streaming replies.

network: Local DSH web profile HTTP route prefix /virtual-companion only
Outbound WebSocket to Microsoft Edge Read Aloud TTS endpoint (wss://speech.platform.bing.com/consumer/speech/synthesize/readaloud/edge/v1) for neural Chinese voice synthesis
